title: MusicFlux: Flexible Conditioning for Text-Guided Music Generation and Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.13834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Music editing transforms existing recordings while preserving their original attributes. Recent approaches adapt pretrained text-to-music models for tasks like inpainting, event insertion, or restoration by conditioning them with context audio. It was recently proposed for image editing to unify generation and editing by treating the source image as in-context information. However, applying this directly to music is computationally expensive due to long audio sequences. In this work, we develop MusicFlux, a text-guided music editor built on an efficient pretrained flow-matching text-to-audio model. We introduce two conditioning approaches that trade off editing performance and computational efficiency. Experiments show that both are competitive with strong baselines, with one achieving better editing quality and the other preserving the original sequence length and substantially improving computational efficiency.

translated_title: MusicFlux：用于文本引导音乐生成与编辑的灵活条件化方法
translated_abstract: 音乐编辑是在保留录音原始属性的同时对其进行变换。近来的方法通过使用上下文音频进行条件化，使预训练的文本到音乐模型适应修复、事件插入或恢复等任务。最近在图像编辑领域提出了一种通过将源图像视为上下文信息来统一生成与编辑的方法。然而，由于音频序列较长，直接将该方法应用于音乐会导致计算成本高昂。在本工作中，我们开发了MusicFlux，一个基于高效预训练流匹配文本到音频模型的文本引导音乐编辑器。我们引入了两种在编辑性能与计算效率之间进行权衡的条件化方法。实验表明，这两种方法均与强大的基线方法具有竞争力，其中一种实现了更好的编辑质量，另一种则保留了原始序列长度并显著提升了计算效率。
tldr: MusicFlux是一个基于预训练流匹配文本到音频模型的文本引导音乐编辑器，通过两种条件化方法在编辑质量与计算效率之间实现权衡，无需处理过长的音频序列即可统一音乐的生成与编辑。
en_tdlr: MusicFlux is a text-guided music editor built on an efficient pretrained flow-matching text-to-audio model, introducing two conditioning approaches that trade off editing quality and computational efficiency to unify music generation and editing.
